messages.subject: Batch on OSX
parts:
Hello...

I have gnuplot installed on a Mac 10.5.
Works just fine in interactive mode.
However, I can't get it to work in batch mode.
If I create a gnuplot script and attempt to run it in batch using:

/Applications/Gnuplot.app/Contents/MacOS/Gnuplot.app test.txt
or
/Applications/Gnuplot.app/Contents/MacOS/Gnuplot.app < test.txt

an interactive session starts and nothing is plotted.

I must be missing something to get this to work in batch.

Any suggestions?

TIA,
Joe
